author: NASASpaceflight
description:
LIVE from the Intrepid Museum Shuttle Pavilion. Discover how space is happening all around you, right here in New York! From life-saving medical research to satellite technology, law, defense, and beyond, New Yorkers are shaping the future of space in ways most people never see. This dynamic panel highlights the unexpected industries, institutions, and individuals that connect New York to the cosmos, revealing how deeply space is woven into everyday life. With engaging stories and big-picture thinking, “Space Is New York” celebrates the state’s growing role in the space economy and invites audiences of all ages to discover how they can be part of it.

Panelists:
Ambericent Cornett: Founder and CEO of The Chameleon Consulting Firm
Neha S. Dagley: Founder of SpaceMarked Legal Advisory, P.A.
Khaki Rodway: CEO and co-founder of Aetherion Space Corp
Corey L. Trusty: U.S. Space Force officer and Military Fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations
Moderator:
Elysia Segal: Producer of Public
title: Space is New York - Intrepid Museum Astro Live
